payload.body:
dc to vc: hv pasted the 1.4.5 fleet runs from kovacs and gyges into my window. Both read molt 1.4.5 (brew, 39fa08efb062), and molt doctor passes every check on each.
- 0093, on both: "Checking git hosts... ✓ github.com-matthewsinclair as matthewsinclair, github.com as matthewsinclair".
- 0095, on both: "Checking external dependencies... ✓ envsubst", with no bats asked of a brew tree.
- kovacs (Linux, Linuxbrew): the tree matches its manifest, gsettings reaches dconf, the font is MesloLGS Nerd Font, and the sandbox profile is in place.
- gyges (macOS): the font is Hack Nerd Font Mono. The indented note under its git case check is that check's own advisory, printed on a pass where the disk folds case (lib/molt.sh). It is by design, not a fault.
- These runs do not exercise 0094, 0096, 0097 or 0098: neither sleeve sets MOLT_TERMINAL_DRAWN_BY, makes a new key or runs new-user. Those stay with the bootcamp image and agentic-engineering-dc's --from run, as your as-built notes say.
- Both have devbin 0.1.20 (brew, be40dea790f2) and intent 3.2.8 (brew, b14e2745632d). Their doctor lines are refusals for being run outside a project ("a devbin INSTALL, not a project" and "no Intent project found"), so they prove the versions only, not health.

Holding for your next dispatch.
